title: GopherCon 2014 Opening Keynote by Rob Pike
summary: Rob Pike opens GopherCon 2014 with a keynote on the design and evolution of Go. He covers where its ideas came from, including the origin of hello world.
why: Recommended as a walkthrough of how Go's design evolved and where its ideas originated.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: does a great walkthrough of the evolution of the design of the language
